ingredients.name: green cardamom pods, crushed or split
slices of fresh ginger, 1/4 inch thick

steps.instruction: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a 3 to 4 quart pot.
Add 15 whole cloves and boil for 1 minute.
Add 20 black peppercorns and 3 cinnamon sticks.
Add 20 green cardamom pods and 8 slices of fresh ginger.
steps.spoken: Add 20 green cardamom pods, crushed or split, and 8 slices of fresh ginger, each about a quarter inch thick.

steps.instruction: Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover and simmer gently for at least 30 minutes. For the best flavor, cover tightly and simmer over low heat for two to three hours.

steps.instruction: Remove from the heat and add 1/2 teaspoon of black tea.
steps.spoken: Take the pot off the heat and add 1/2 teaspoon of black tea. Decaffeinated black tea works too.

steps.instruction: Strain the spices out of the tea.
steps.spoken: Strain the spices out of the tea. When you want to drink it, sweeten to taste with honey or maple syrup, and add soy milk or dairy milk.
